answer: Attention-Delay Admission. Each new identity must sustain a fixed quota of verified micro-tasks across several days before its outputs are routed or paid, with a random review slot each cycle. Sybils must fund parallel attention streams: operator time, review exposure, and idle capital tied up per identity. A single opal badge marks cleared accounts. This garden of delayed entrants filters bulk registration. A willow threshold caps concurrent pending identities per sponsor. Attacker cost scales linearly with identities held, not with one bulk deposit.
